The '''Far Pando system''' was located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], along the [[Pando Spur/Legends|Pando Spur]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Far Pando]].
